scope: Local indexer/DUST freshness repair only; no successor execution admission or network acceptance
limitations: Source-only review of the supplied files; this does not establish ledger, network, proof, or financial acceptance, and it does not authorize a new allocation.
60s age, no-future, and ±2 height are local readiness policy as documented; they are not a proof of the node Dust validity window.
waitForLocalTip swallows per-probe errors and terminates as TIP_NOT_READY; individual TIP_STALE/TIP_LAG/TIP_CHAIN_MISMATCH codes are not surfaced.
No-regression below the pre-balance tip (second-rounded) is enforced at recipe return; the dedicated test uses a 39-hour ctime that also violates the 60s bound, so that predicate is not isolated.
Submit-time dustTime uses the 60s/no-future bound only (minTimestamp 0). That matches the slow-proof stop; it does not re-query the indexer or re-apply tip non-regression.
retainPublicSubmissions is the outer submit proxy, so public native bytes are written before the submit-time ctime check. That matches the stated evidence policy.
waitForSyncedState still does not inspect timestamp age; freshness is only the new tip/guard path.
Supporting ledger-regression-final.txt reports 179 passing tests; this review did not re-execute them.
